SCOPE: function EXPLANATION: Use a static template string and pass user-provided values as context variables to prevent Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI). ```python @app.route('/profile') def profile(): # -------------------------------------------- username = request.args.get('name', session.get('username', 'Guest')) comment = request.args.get('comment', 'No comment') # -------------------------------------------- template = '''

User Profile

Welcome, {{ username }}!

Your comment: {{ comment }}

{% if is_admin %}

Password Hint: {{ admin_password }}

{% endif %} ''' is_admin = username == 'admin' admin_password = ADMIN_PASSWORD if is_admin else None return render_template_string( template, username=username, comment=comment, is_admin=is_admin, admin_password=admin_password ) ```
